scholarships.title: Australia Awards Mekong-Australia Partnership (MAP) Scholarships
scholarships.official_source: Department of Foreign Affairs and Trade (DFAT), Australian Government

eligibility: Citizen of Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam, Laos, or Myanmar.
Meet general Australia Awards Scholarships eligibility requirements.
Proposed Master's study or research must align with MAP thematic areas.
Meet English proficiency and visa requirements.
existing.eligibility_summary: Citizen of Thailand, Cambodia, Vietnam, Laos, or Myanmar; meet general Australia Awards eligibility; proposed study must fall within MAP thematic areas (water security, climate resilience, etc.).
benefits: Exclusive access to Mekong-Leaders Network on-award enrichment program
coverage: Exclusive access to Mekong-Leaders Network on-award enrichment program
documents: Study plan aligned with MAP thematic areas
existing.english_requirement: IELTS 6.5 overall (no band less than 6.0) or equivalent.
application_method: Online via OASIS portal (same as Australia Awards Scholarships)
existing.best_fit: Mid-career professionals from Mekong subregion countries seeking Master's study in MAP thematic areas.
existing.notes: MAP is a sub-program of Australia Awards Scholarships with additional Mekong-Leaders Network enrichment. Applicants from Thailand use the Thailand Australia Awards intake portal; other MAP countries use standard AAS portals. Applicants may apply for both AAS and MAP-funded scholarships in their respective countries.
existing.application_period: Same as Australia Awards Scholarships for respective countries (e.g., 2027 intake: 1 Feb – 30 Apr 2026)
